<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>棵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kē</rt></ruby><ruby>树<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shù</rt></ruby><ruby>栽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zāi</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>溪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby><ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>旁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pánɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>按<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby><ruby>结<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby><ruby>果<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>叶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yè</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>枯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kū</rt></ruby><ruby>干<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡān</rt></ruby>。<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fán</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby>做<ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>尽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>顺<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shùn</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">È</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>乃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>糠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>秕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>风<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>吹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuī</rt></ruby><ruby>散<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sàn</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>审<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shěn</rt></ruby><ruby>判<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pàn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby>、<ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>站<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhàn</rt></ruby><ruby>立<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby>；<ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>会<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby>；<ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby><ruby>却<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>灭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miè</rt></ruby><ruby>亡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wánɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>外<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wài</rt></ruby><ruby>邦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>争<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>闹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nào</rt></ruby>？<ruby>万<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wàn</rt></ruby><ruby>民<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mín</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>谋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">móu</rt></ruby><ruby>算<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suàn</rt></ruby><ruby>虚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xū</rt></ruby><ruby>妄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>？
verses.heading: 神所拣选的君王

verses.text: <ruby>世<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shì</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>君<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jūn</rt></ruby><ruby>王<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>齐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>臣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chén</rt></ruby><ruby>宰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>商<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>议<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>敌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dí</rt></ruby><ruby>挡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>膏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>者<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhě</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>挣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>开<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kāi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>捆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǔn</rt></ruby><ruby>绑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>脱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tuō</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>绳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>索<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nà</rt></ruby><ruby>坐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>笑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiào</rt></ruby>；<ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>嗤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>笑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nà</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>怒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nù</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>责<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zé</rt></ruby><ruby>备<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>烈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby><ruby>怒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nù</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>惊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>吓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>已<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>经<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>立<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>君<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jūn</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>锡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xī</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>圣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>山<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shān</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>膏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>者<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhě</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>传<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuán</rt></ruby><ruby>圣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>旨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby>。<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>曾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>今<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīn</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby><ruby>国<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuó</rt></ruby><ruby>赐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cì</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>基<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jī</rt></ruby><ruby>业<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yè</rt></ruby>，<ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>极<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby><ruby>赐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cì</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>田<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tián</rt></ruby><ruby>产<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chǎn</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>铁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiě</rt></ruby><ruby>杖<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>打<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>破<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pò</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>；<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>窑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yáo</rt></ruby><ruby>匠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>瓦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>器<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby><ruby>摔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuāi</rt></ruby><ruby>碎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suì</rt></ruby>。’”

<ruby>现<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>君<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jūn</rt></ruby><ruby>王<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>应<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>省<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>悟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby>！<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>世<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>审<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shěn</rt></ruby><ruby>判<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pàn</rt></ruby><ruby>官<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuān</rt></ruby><ruby>该<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāi</rt></ruby><ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>管<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>教<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby>！

<ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>存<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cún</rt></ruby><ruby>畏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>惧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jù</rt></ruby><ruby>侍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>奉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby>，<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>存<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cún</rt></ruby><ruby>战<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhàn</rt></ruby><ruby>兢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>而<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>快<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuài</rt></ruby><ruby>乐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lè</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>应<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>畏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>惧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>犯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fàn</rt></ruby><ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby>；<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>床<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby>，<ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>思<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby><ruby>想<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>肃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sù</rt></ruby><ruby>静<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby>。<ruby>细<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xì</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby>

<ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>献<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>公<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>倚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>靠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kào</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>许<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>谁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shuí</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>指<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>示<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>处<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chù</rt></ruby>？”<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>仰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>脸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>照<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhào</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>快<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuài</rt></ruby><ruby>乐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lè</rt></ruby>，<ruby>胜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>丰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>收<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shōu</rt></ruby><ruby>五<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>谷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>新<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>酒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby><ruby>然<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rán</rt></ruby><ruby>躺<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>睡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuì</rt></ruby><ruby>觉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>独<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dú</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby><ruby>然<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rán</rt></ruby><ruby>居<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jū</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>留<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liú</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>言<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yán</rt></ruby><ruby>语<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>顾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡù</rt></ruby><ruby>念<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niàn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>思<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">si</rt></ruby>！

verses.text: <ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>王<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>垂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuí</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>呼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hū</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>声<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>音<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby>！<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>祈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>祷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>早<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>晨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chen</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>声<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>音<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby>；<ruby>早<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>晨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chen</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>陈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chén</rt></ruby><ruby>明<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>意<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>警<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>醒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐnɡ</rt></ruby>！

<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>喜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>悦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuè</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>居<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jū</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>狂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Kuánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>傲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ào</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>站<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhàn</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>眼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby>；<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>孽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niè</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>恨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hèn</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>谎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>言<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yán</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>灭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miè</rt></ruby><ruby>绝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jué</rt></ruby>；<ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Hào</rt></ruby><ruby>流<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liú</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>血<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xuè</rt></ruby><ruby>弄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>诡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>诈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhà</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>憎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby><ruby>孽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niè</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>手<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby><ruby>报<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bào</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>交<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiāo</rt></ruby><ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>（<ruby>连<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lián</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wú</rt></ruby><ruby>故<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡù</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>敌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dí</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>救<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>），

<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>任<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rèn</rt></ruby><ruby>凭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>仇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chóu</rt></ruby><ruby>敌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dí</rt></ruby><ruby>追<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuī</rt></ruby><ruby>赶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>直<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhí</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>追<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuī</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>性<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>命<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>踏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tà</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby>，<ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>荣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>耀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>归<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuī</rt></ruby><ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>灰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huī</rt></ruby><ruby>尘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chén</rt></ruby>。<ruby>细<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xì</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby>

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>怒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nù</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>挺<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>身<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>而<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>立<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>抵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>挡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>敌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dí</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>暴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bào</rt></ruby><ruby>怒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nù</rt></ruby>！<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>兴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby>！<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>已<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>经<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>命<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>定<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>施<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shī</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>审<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shěn</rt></ruby><ruby>判<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pàn</rt></ruby>！

<ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>民<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mín</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>会<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby><ruby>环<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huán</rt></ruby><ruby>绕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rào</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>！<ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>其<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>归<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuī</rt></ruby><ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>高<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>位<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby>！

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>仇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chóu</rt></ruby><ruby>敌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dí</rt></ruby><ruby>转<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>身<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>退<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tuì</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>跌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diē</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>灭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miè</rt></ruby><ruby>亡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wánɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>已<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>经<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>伸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>冤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuān</rt></ruby>，<ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>辨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>屈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qū</rt></ruby>；<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>坐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>宝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>座<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>按<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby><ruby>公<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>审<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shěn</rt></ruby><ruby>判<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pàn</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>曾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>斥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chì</rt></ruby><ruby>责<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zé</rt></ruby><ruby>外<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wài</rt></ruby><ruby>邦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bānɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>曾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>灭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miè</rt></ruby><ruby>绝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jué</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>；<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>曾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>涂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>抹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>直<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhí</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>永<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>永<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>远<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>远<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuǎn</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>仇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Chóu</rt></ruby><ruby>敌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dí</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>尽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tóu</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>毁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>坏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huài</rt></ruby>，<ruby>直<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhí</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>永<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>远<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuǎn</rt></ruby>。<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>拆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chāi</rt></ruby><ruby>毁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>城<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>邑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>连<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lián</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>号<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hào</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>归<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuī</rt></ruby><ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wú</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>惟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>坐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>王<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wánɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>直<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhí</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>永<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>远<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuǎn</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>已<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>经<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>审<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shěn</rt></ruby><ruby>判<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pàn</rt></ruby><ruby>设<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shè</rt></ruby><ruby>摆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>宝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>座<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>按<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby><ruby>公<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>审<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shěn</rt></ruby><ruby>判<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pàn</rt></ruby><ruby>世<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>界<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiè</rt></ruby>，<ruby>按<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby><ruby>正<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>直<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhí</rt></ruby><ruby>判<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pàn</rt></ruby><ruby>断<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duàn</rt></ruby><ruby>万<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wàn</rt></ruby><ruby>民<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mín</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>欺<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby><ruby>压<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>高<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>台<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>患<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huàn</rt></ruby><ruby>难<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nàn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>高<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>台<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tái</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>认<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rèn</rt></ruby><ruby>识<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>倚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>靠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kào</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>离<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lí</rt></ruby><ruby>弃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby><ruby>寻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xún</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>应<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>歌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡē</rt></ruby><ruby>颂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>居<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jū</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>锡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby>，<ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>传<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuán</rt></ruby><ruby>扬<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>民<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mín</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>追<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuī</rt></ruby><ruby>讨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>流<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liú</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>血<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xuè</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>记<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>念<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niàn</rt></ruby><ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>屈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qū</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>忘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>记<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>困<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kùn</rt></ruby><ruby>苦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>哀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">āi</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>孤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡū</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>欺<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby><ruby>压<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>伸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>冤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuān</rt></ruby>，<ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>强<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>横<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>再<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>威<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wēi</rt></ruby><ruby>吓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hè</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>投<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tóu</rt></ruby><ruby>靠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kào</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby>；<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>怎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zěn</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>鸟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>飞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēi</rt></ruby><ruby>往<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>山<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shān</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>。
verses.heading: 在主里得安稳

verses.text: <ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>哪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>弯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wān</rt></ruby><ruby>弓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>箭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>搭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dā</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>弦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xián</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>暗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>射<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shè</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>正<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>直<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhí</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>根<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Gēn</rt></ruby><ruby>基<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jī</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>毁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>坏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huài</rt></ruby>，<ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>还<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby>做<ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>圣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>殿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diàn</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>宝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>座<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>慧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby><ruby>眼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>察<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chá</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>世<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>试<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>验<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yàn</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>；<ruby>惟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>喜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>爱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ài</rt></ruby><ruby>强<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>暴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bào</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>恨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hèn</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>密<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mì</rt></ruby><ruby>布<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>网<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>罗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">luó</rt></ruby>；<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>烈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby><ruby>火<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǒ</rt></ruby>、<ruby>硫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liú</rt></ruby><ruby>磺<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huánɡ</rt></ruby>、<ruby>热<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rè</rt></ruby><ruby>风<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>杯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bēi</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>份<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fèn</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>公<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>喜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>爱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ài</rt></ruby><ruby>公<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby>；<ruby>正<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>直<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhí</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>帮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>助<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>虔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>诚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>断<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duàn</rt></ruby><ruby>绝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jué</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>；<ruby>世<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>间<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>忠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。
verses.heading: 求助的祈祷

verses.text: <ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Rén</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>邻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lín</rt></ruby><ruby>舍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shè</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>谎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǎnɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby>，<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>嘴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>唇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chún</rt></ruby><ruby>油<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yóu</rt></ruby><ruby>滑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby>，<ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>口<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fán</rt></ruby><ruby>油<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yóu</rt></ruby><ruby>滑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>嘴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>唇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chún</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>夸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuā</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>舌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shé</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tou</rt></ruby>，<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>剪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>除<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chú</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>曾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>舌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shé</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tou</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>胜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>嘴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>唇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chún</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>谁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuí</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？”

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>美<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">měi</rt></ruby><ruby>福<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby><ruby>迎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>接<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiē</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>精<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>金<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>冠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuān</rt></ruby><ruby>冕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>戴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tóu</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>寿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>便<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>赐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cì</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>久<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǔ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>直<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhí</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>永<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>远<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuǎn</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>救<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>恩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ēn</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>荣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>耀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby>；<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>尊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zūn</rt></ruby><ruby>荣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>威<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wēi</rt></ruby><ruby>严<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yán</rt></ruby><ruby>加<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>身<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>洪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>福<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby>，<ruby>直<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhí</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>永<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>远<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuǎn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>欢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huān</rt></ruby><ruby>喜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>快<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuài</rt></ruby><ruby>乐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lè</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>王<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>倚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>靠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kào</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>至<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>高<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>者<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhě</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>慈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cí</rt></ruby><ruby>爱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ài</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>摇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yáo</rt></ruby><ruby>动<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dònɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>手<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>搜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sōu</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby><ruby>仇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chóu</rt></ruby><ruby>敌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dí</rt></ruby>；<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>右<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>手<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>搜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sōu</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>些<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiē</rt></ruby><ruby>恨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hèn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>怒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nù</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby>，<ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>炎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yán</rt></ruby><ruby>热<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rè</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>火<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>炉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lú</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby>。<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>震<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhèn</rt></ruby><ruby>怒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nù</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>吞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tūn</rt></ruby><ruby>灭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miè</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>；<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>火<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>烧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shāo</rt></ruby><ruby>尽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>世<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>灭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miè</rt></ruby><ruby>绝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jué</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>孙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sūn</rt></ruby>（<ruby>原<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuán</rt></ruby><ruby>文<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wén</rt></ruby>是<ruby>果<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>），<ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>间<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>灭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miè</rt></ruby><ruby>绝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jué</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>裔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>意<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>加<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>害<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hài</rt></ruby><ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>想<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>计<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>谋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">móu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>却<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>成<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>转<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>背<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>逃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">táo</rt></ruby><ruby>跑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pǎo</rt></ruby>，<ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>脸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>搭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dā</rt></ruby><ruby>箭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>弦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xián</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>力<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>显<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>至<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>高<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby>！<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>唱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>诗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shī</rt></ruby>，<ruby>歌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡē</rt></ruby><ruby>颂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby>！<ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>离<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lí</rt></ruby><ruby>弃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>？<ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>远<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>离<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lí</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>救<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>？<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>唉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">āi</rt></ruby><ruby>哼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>言<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yán</rt></ruby><ruby>语<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby>？
verses.heading: 痛苦中的祷告和赞美

verses.text: <ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>白<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bái</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby><ruby>呼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hū</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>应<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>允<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>夜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yè</rt></ruby><ruby>间<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>呼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hū</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby>，<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>声<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>亮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuānɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>拯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhěnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>救<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>还<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby><ruby>怕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pà</rt></ruby><ruby>谁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuí</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>性<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>命<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>保<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>障<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhànɡ</rt></ruby>（“<ruby>保<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>障<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhànɡ</rt></ruby>”<ruby>或<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huò</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby>“<ruby>力<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>量<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liànɡ</rt></ruby>”），<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>还<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby><ruby>惧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jù</rt></ruby><ruby>谁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuí</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？
