verses.text: <ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nà</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>仇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chóu</rt></ruby><ruby>敌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dí</rt></ruby>，<ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>肉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ròu</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>绊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bàn</rt></ruby><ruby>跌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diē</rt></ruby><ruby>仆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pú</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>虽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Suī</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>军<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jūn</rt></ruby><ruby>兵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby><ruby>营<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>攻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>击<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jī</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>害<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hài</rt></ruby><ruby>怕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pà</rt></ruby>；<ruby>虽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suī</rt></ruby><ruby>然<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rán</rt></ruby><ruby>兴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>刀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dāo</rt></ruby><ruby>兵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>攻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>击<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jī</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>仍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>旧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby><ruby>稳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wěn</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>件<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>曾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>仍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>寻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xún</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby>：<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>世<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>殿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diàn</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>瞻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhān</rt></ruby><ruby>仰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>荣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>美<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">měi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>殿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diàn</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>问<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèn</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>遭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zāo</rt></ruby><ruby>遇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><ruby>患<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huàn</rt></ruby><ruby>难<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>暗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby><ruby>暗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>保<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>守<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>亭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>藏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>帐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>幕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>隐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐn</rt></ruby><ruby>密<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mì</rt></ruby><ruby>处<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>高<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>举<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>磐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pán</rt></ruby><ruby>石<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>现<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>昂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>首<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>高<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>四<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sì</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>仇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chóu</rt></ruby><ruby>敌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dí</rt></ruby>。<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>帐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>幕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>欢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huān</rt></ruby><ruby>然<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rán</rt></ruby><ruby>献<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby>；<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>唱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>诗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shī</rt></ruby><ruby>歌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡē</rt></ruby><ruby>颂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>声<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>音<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>呼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hū</rt></ruby><ruby>吁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby>，<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>垂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuí</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>怜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lián</rt></ruby><ruby>恤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xù</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>应<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>允<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>寻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xún</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby>。”<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nà</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>正<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>寻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xún</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>洪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Hónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>泛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fàn</rt></ruby><ruby>滥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">làn</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby>，<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>坐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>王<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wánɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>坐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>王<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wánɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>直<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhí</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>永<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>远<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuǎn</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>赐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cì</rt></ruby><ruby>力<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>量<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>百<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>姓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìnɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>赐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cì</rt></ruby><ruby>平<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>福<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>百<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>姓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìnɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>尊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zūn</rt></ruby><ruby>崇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>曾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>提<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tí</rt></ruby><ruby>拔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bá</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>仇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chóu</rt></ruby><ruby>敌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dí</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>夸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuā</rt></ruby><ruby>耀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby>。

verses.text: <ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>曾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>呼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hū</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>医<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>治<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>曾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>灵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">línɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>魂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hún</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>阴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>间<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>救<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>存<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cún</rt></ruby><ruby>活<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huó</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>至<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>坑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kēnɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>圣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>民<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mín</rt></ruby><ruby>哪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>歌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡē</rt></ruby><ruby>颂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>称<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>赞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zàn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>记<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>念<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niàn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>圣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>怒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nù</rt></ruby><ruby>气<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>转<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>眼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>间<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>恩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ēn</rt></ruby><ruby>典<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>乃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>久<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǔ</rt></ruby>。<ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yī</rt></ruby><ruby>宿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>虽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suī</rt></ruby><ruby>然<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rán</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>哭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kū</rt></ruby><ruby>泣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>早<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>晨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chen</rt></ruby><ruby>便<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>欢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huān</rt></ruby><ruby>呼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hū</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>至<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>平<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>顺<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shùn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>便<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>永<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>动<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>摇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yáo</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>曾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>施<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shī</rt></ruby><ruby>恩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ēn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>江<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>山<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shān</rt></ruby><ruby>稳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wěn</rt></ruby><ruby>固<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡù</rt></ruby>；<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>掩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>惊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>惶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huánɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>曾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>恳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kěn</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby>，<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：

“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>害<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hài</rt></ruby><ruby>流<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liú</rt></ruby><ruby>血<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xuè</rt></ruby>，<ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>坑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>益<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>处<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chù</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？<ruby>尘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chén</rt></ruby><ruby>土<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>岂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>称<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>赞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zàn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>传<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuán</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>诚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>实<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>吗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mɑ</rt></ruby>？

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>应<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>允<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>怜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lián</rt></ruby><ruby>恤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xù</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>！<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>帮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>助<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>！”

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>已<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>哀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">āi</rt></ruby><ruby>哭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kū</rt></ruby><ruby>变<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>跳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiào</rt></ruby><ruby>舞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǔ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>麻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">má</rt></ruby><ruby>衣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>脱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tuō</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>披<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pī</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>喜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>乐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lè</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>灵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">línɡ</rt></ruby>（<ruby>原<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuán</rt></ruby><ruby>文<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wén</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby>“<ruby>荣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>耀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby>”）<ruby>歌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡē</rt></ruby><ruby>颂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>声<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby>。<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>称<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>谢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiè</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>直<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhí</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>永<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>远<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuǎn</rt></ruby>！

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>投<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tóu</rt></ruby><ruby>靠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kào</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>永<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>羞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiū</rt></ruby><ruby>愧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuì</rt></ruby>；<ruby>凭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>公<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>搭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dā</rt></ruby><ruby>救<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>！

verses.text: <ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>侧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cè</rt></ruby><ruby>耳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ěr</rt></ruby><ruby>而<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>快<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuài</rt></ruby><ruby>快<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuài</rt></ruby><ruby>救<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>！<ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>坚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>固<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡù</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>磐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pán</rt></ruby><ruby>石<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby>，<ruby>拯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhěnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>救<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>保<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>障<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhànɡ</rt></ruby>！

<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>岩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yán</rt></ruby><ruby>石<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>山<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shān</rt></ruby><ruby>寨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhài</rt></ruby>；<ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>缘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuán</rt></ruby><ruby>故<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡù</rt></ruby><ruby>引<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐn</rt></ruby><ruby>导<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>指<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>点<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>救<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>脱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tuō</rt></ruby><ruby>离<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lí</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>暗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby><ruby>设<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shè</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>网<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>罗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">luó</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>保<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>障<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhànɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>灵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">línɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>魂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hún</rt></ruby><ruby>交<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiāo</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>手<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>诚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>实<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>救<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>赎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shú</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>恨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hèn</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby><ruby>奉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>虚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xū</rt></ruby><ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wú</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>；<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>却<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>倚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>靠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kào</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>慈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cí</rt></ruby><ruby>爱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ài</rt></ruby><ruby>高<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>兴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>欢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huān</rt></ruby><ruby>喜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>困<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kùn</rt></ruby><ruby>苦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǔ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>艰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>难<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nán</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>未<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>曾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>交<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiāo</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>仇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chóu</rt></ruby><ruby>敌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dí</rt></ruby><ruby>手<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>脚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>站<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhàn</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>宽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuān</rt></ruby><ruby>阔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuò</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>处<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chù</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>怜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lián</rt></ruby><ruby>恤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xù</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>急<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby><ruby>难<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nàn</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>眼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>睛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jinɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>忧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yōu</rt></ruby><ruby>愁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chóu</rt></ruby><ruby>而<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>干<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡān</rt></ruby><ruby>瘪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biě</rt></ruby>，<ruby>连<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lián</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>身<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby><ruby>舒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shū</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>命<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>愁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chóu</rt></ruby><ruby>苦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>消<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiāo</rt></ruby><ruby>耗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hào</rt></ruby>；<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>年<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nián</rt></ruby><ruby>岁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suì</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>叹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tàn</rt></ruby><ruby>息<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>旷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>废<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fèi</rt></ruby>。<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>力<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>量<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby><ruby>孽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niè</rt></ruby><ruby>衰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuāi</rt></ruby><ruby>败<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bài</rt></ruby>；<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>骨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tou</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>枯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kū</rt></ruby><ruby>干<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡān</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby><ruby>敌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dí</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>成<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>羞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiū</rt></ruby><ruby>辱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rǔ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>邻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lín</rt></ruby><ruby>舍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shě</rt></ruby><ruby>跟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡēn</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>更<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>甚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shèn</rt></ruby>；<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>认<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rèn</rt></ruby><ruby>识<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shi</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>惧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jù</rt></ruby><ruby>怕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pà</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>外<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wài</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tou</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>躲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>避<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>忘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>记<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wú</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>记<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>念<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niàn</rt></ruby>；<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>破<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pò</rt></ruby><ruby>碎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suì</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>器<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby><ruby>皿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǐn</rt></ruby>。

verses.text: <ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fán</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>诡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>诈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhà</rt></ruby>，<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>算<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suàn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>福<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>！

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>闭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>口<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>认<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rèn</rt></ruby><ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>终<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby><ruby>唉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">āi</rt></ruby><ruby>哼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>而<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>骨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tou</rt></ruby><ruby>枯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kū</rt></ruby><ruby>干<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡān</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>黑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Hēi</rt></ruby><ruby>夜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yè</rt></ruby><ruby>白<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bái</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>手<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>身<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>沉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chén</rt></ruby><ruby>重<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>精<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby>力<ruby>耗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hào</rt></ruby><ruby>尽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>夏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>干<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡān</rt></ruby><ruby>旱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hàn</rt></ruby>。<ruby>细<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xì</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby>

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>陈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chén</rt></ruby><ruby>明<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>隐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐn</rt></ruby><ruby>瞒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mán</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby>。<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>承<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>认<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rèn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>犯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fàn</rt></ruby>。”<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>赦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shè</rt></ruby><ruby>免<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby>。<ruby>细<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xì</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby>

<ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>虔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>诚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>趁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chèn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>寻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xún</rt></ruby><ruby>找<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby><ruby>祷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>泛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fàn</rt></ruby><ruby>溢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby>，<ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>藏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>身<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>处<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chù</rt></ruby>；<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>保<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>佑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>脱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tuō</rt></ruby><ruby>离<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lí</rt></ruby><ruby>苦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>难<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>救<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>乐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lè</rt></ruby><ruby>歌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡē</rt></ruby><ruby>四<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sì</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>环<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huán</rt></ruby><ruby>绕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rào</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>。<ruby>细<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xì</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby>

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>教<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>导<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>指<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>示<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby>；<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>定<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>睛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>身<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>劝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quàn</rt></ruby><ruby>戒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiè</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wú</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>骡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">luó</rt></ruby><ruby>马<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>嚼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiáo</rt></ruby><ruby>环<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huán</rt></ruby><ruby>辔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pèi</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tóu</rt></ruby><ruby>勒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lēi</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>它<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>；<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>然<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rán</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>驯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xùn</rt></ruby><ruby>服<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">È</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby><ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>苦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>楚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chǔ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>惟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>独<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dú</rt></ruby><ruby>倚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>靠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kào</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>慈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cí</rt></ruby><ruby>爱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ài</rt></ruby><ruby>四<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sì</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>环<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huán</rt></ruby><ruby>绕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>应<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>靠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kào</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>欢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huān</rt></ruby><ruby>喜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>快<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuài</rt></ruby><ruby>乐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lè</rt></ruby>；<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>正<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>直<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhí</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>欢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huān</rt></ruby><ruby>呼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hū</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>哪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>应<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>靠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kào</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>欢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huān</rt></ruby><ruby>乐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lè</rt></ruby>；<ruby>正<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>直<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhí</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>赞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zàn</rt></ruby><ruby>美<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">měi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>合<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>宜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。

verses.text: <ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>应<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>弹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tán</rt></ruby><ruby>琴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qín</rt></ruby><ruby>称<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>谢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiè</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby>，<ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>弦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xián</rt></ruby><ruby>瑟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>歌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡē</rt></ruby><ruby>颂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>应<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>唱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>新<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>歌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡē</rt></ruby>，<ruby>弹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tán</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>巧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>妙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miào</rt></ruby>，<ruby>声<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>音<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>洪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>亮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liànɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wú</rt></ruby><ruby>故<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡù</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>暗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby><ruby>设<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shè</rt></ruby><ruby>网<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>罗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">luó</rt></ruby>，<ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wú</rt></ruby><ruby>故<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡù</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>挖<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wā</rt></ruby><ruby>坑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kēnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>害<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hài</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>性<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>命<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mìnɡ</rt></ruby>。

verses.text: <ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>公<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>高<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>山<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shān</rt></ruby>；<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>判<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pàn</rt></ruby><ruby>断<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duàn</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>深<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>渊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuān</rt></ruby>。<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>民<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mín</rt></ruby>、<ruby>牲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>畜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>救<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>护<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hù</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>慈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cí</rt></ruby><ruby>爱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ài</rt></ruby><ruby>何<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>其<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>宝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>贵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuì</rt></ruby>！<ruby>世<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>投<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tóu</rt></ruby><ruby>靠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kào</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>翅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chì</rt></ruby><ruby>膀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>荫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>殿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diàn</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>肥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">féi</rt></ruby><ruby>甘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡān</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>饱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>足<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zú</rt></ruby>；<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>喝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hē</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>乐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lè</rt></ruby><ruby>河<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǐ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>命<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>源<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuán</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tóu</rt></ruby>；<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuānɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>常<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>施<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shī</rt></ruby><ruby>慈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cí</rt></ruby><ruby>爱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ài</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>认<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rèn</rt></ruby><ruby>识<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>常<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>公<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>待<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>正<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>直<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhí</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bù</rt></ruby><ruby>容<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>骄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiāo</rt></ruby><ruby>傲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ào</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>脚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>践<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>踏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tà</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>容<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>凶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>手<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>赶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>逐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhú</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zài</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>孽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niè</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>已<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>经<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>仆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pú</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>推<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tuī</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>再<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>怀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huái</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>平<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pínɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>嫉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby><ruby>妒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dù</rt></ruby>。

verses.text: <ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>草<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>快<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuài</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>割<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡē</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby>，<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>青<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>菜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cài</rt></ruby><ruby>快<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuài</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>枯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kū</rt></ruby><ruby>干<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡān</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>倚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>靠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kào</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>而<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>善<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby><ruby>实<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>粮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liánɡ</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>乐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lè</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>赐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cì</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>交<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiāo</rt></ruby><ruby>托<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tuō</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby>，<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>倚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>靠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>成<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>全<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>公<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby>，<ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>公<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>平<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>明<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>正<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>午<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǔ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>默<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mò</rt></ruby><ruby>然<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rán</rt></ruby><ruby>倚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>靠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kào</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby>，<ruby>耐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nài</rt></ruby><ruby>性<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>等<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">děnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>；<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby><ruby>通<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>达<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dá</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby><ruby>谋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">móu</rt></ruby><ruby>成<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>怀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huái</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>平<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pínɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nà</rt></ruby><ruby>寻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xún</rt></ruby><ruby>索<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>命<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>设<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shè</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>网<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>罗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">luó</rt></ruby>；<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>想<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>害<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hài</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>口<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby><ruby>言<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yán</rt></ruby>，<ruby>终<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby><ruby>思<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby><ruby>想<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>诡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>计<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>聋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>哑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>巴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bɑ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>开<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kāi</rt></ruby><ruby>口<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒu</rt></ruby>。
