verses.text: <ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>开<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kāi</rt></ruby><ruby>恩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ēn</rt></ruby><ruby>搭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dā</rt></ruby><ruby>救<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>！<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>速<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sù</rt></ruby><ruby>速<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sù</rt></ruby><ruby>帮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>助<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>！

<ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>些<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiē</rt></ruby><ruby>寻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xún</rt></ruby><ruby>找<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>、<ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>灭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miè</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>命<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>抱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bào</rt></ruby><ruby>愧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuì</rt></ruby><ruby>蒙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ménɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>羞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiū</rt></ruby>！<ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>些<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiē</rt></ruby><ruby>喜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>悦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuè</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>害<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hài</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>退<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tuì</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>辱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rǔ</rt></ruby>！

<ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>些<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiē</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>“<ruby>阿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Ā</rt></ruby><ruby>哈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hā</rt></ruby>、<ruby>阿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ā</rt></ruby><ruby>哈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hā</rt></ruby>”<ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>羞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiū</rt></ruby><ruby>愧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuì</rt></ruby><ruby>而<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>败<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bài</rt></ruby><ruby>亡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wánɡ</rt></ruby>！

<ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby><ruby>寻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xún</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>高<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>兴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>欢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huān</rt></ruby><ruby>喜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby>！<ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>些<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiē</rt></ruby><ruby>喜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>爱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ài</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>救<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>恩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ēn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>常<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>尊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zūn</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby>！”

<ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>困<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kùn</rt></ruby><ruby>苦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>穷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>乏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fá</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>仍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>顾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡù</rt></ruby><ruby>念<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niàn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>帮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>助<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>搭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dā</rt></ruby><ruby>救<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>耽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dān</rt></ruby><ruby>延<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yán</rt></ruby>！

verses.text: <ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>保<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>全<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>存<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cún</rt></ruby><ruby>活<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huó</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>享<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>福<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby>。<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>交<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiāo</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>仇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chóu</rt></ruby><ruby>敌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dí</rt></ruby>，<ruby>遂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suì</rt></ruby><ruby>其<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>病<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>重<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>榻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tà</rt></ruby>，<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>扶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby><ruby>持<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chí</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>病<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>铺<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pū</rt></ruby><ruby>床<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuánɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>曾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>怜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lián</rt></ruby><ruby>恤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xù</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>医<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>治<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>！<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>仇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chóu</rt></ruby><ruby>敌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dí</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby><ruby>言<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yán</rt></ruby><ruby>议<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>论<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lùn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>几<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>才<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cái</rt></ruby><ruby>灭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miè</rt></ruby><ruby>亡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？”

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>假<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>存<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cún</rt></ruby><ruby>奸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby>，<ruby>走<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>外<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wài</rt></ruby><ruby>边<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biān</rt></ruby><ruby>才<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cái</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yí</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby><ruby>恨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hèn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>交<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiāo</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tóu</rt></ruby><ruby>接<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiē</rt></ruby><ruby>耳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ěr</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>议<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>论<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lùn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>设<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shè</rt></ruby><ruby>计<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>害<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hài</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>怪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuài</rt></ruby><ruby>病<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>贴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiē</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>身<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>已<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>躺<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>卧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wò</rt></ruby>，<ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>再<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>连<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Lián</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>朋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>友<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">you</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>倚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>靠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kào</rt></ruby>、<ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>饭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fàn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>脚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>踢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tī</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>怜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lián</rt></ruby><ruby>恤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xù</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>报<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bào</rt></ruby><ruby>复<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>！

<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>仇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chóu</rt></ruby><ruby>敌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dí</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>夸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuā</rt></ruby><ruby>胜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>便<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>喜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>爱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ài</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>纯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chún</rt></ruby><ruby>正<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>扶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby><ruby>持<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chí</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>永<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>远<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>站<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhàn</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>应<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>称<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>颂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>亘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡèn</rt></ruby><ruby>古<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>直<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhí</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>永<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>远<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuǎn</rt></ruby>。<ruby>阿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>！<ruby>阿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>！

<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby><ruby>慕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>鹿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby><ruby>慕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>溪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby><ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǐ</rt></ruby>。
verses.heading: 流亡异乡者的祷告（一）

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>昼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhòu</rt></ruby><ruby>夜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yè</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>眼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>泪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lèi</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>饮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐn</rt></ruby><ruby>食<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby>；<ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>哪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？”

<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>外<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wài</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>攻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>击<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jī</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>强<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>暴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bào</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>寻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xún</rt></ruby><ruby>索<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>命<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mìnɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>眼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby>。<ruby>细<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xì</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby>

<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>帮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>助<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>扶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby><ruby>持<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chí</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>命<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>报<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bào</rt></ruby><ruby>应<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>仇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chóu</rt></ruby><ruby>敌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dí</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby>；<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>凭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>诚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>实<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>灭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miè</rt></ruby><ruby>绝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jué</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>甘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡān</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>献<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>。<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>称<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>赞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zàn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>本<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">běn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>美<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">měi</rt></ruby><ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>急<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby><ruby>难<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nàn</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>救<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>；<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>眼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>睛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jinɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>仇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chóu</rt></ruby><ruby>敌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dí</rt></ruby><ruby>遭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zāo</rt></ruby><ruby>报<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bào</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>留<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liú</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>祷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>隐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐn</rt></ruby><ruby>藏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>恳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kěn</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby>！

verses.text: <ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>侧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cè</rt></ruby><ruby>耳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ěr</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>应<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>允<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>。<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>哀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">āi</rt></ruby><ruby>叹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tàn</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby>，<ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>声<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>唉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">āi</rt></ruby><ruby>哼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hēnɡ</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>仇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chóu</rt></ruby><ruby>敌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dí</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>声<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>音<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>欺<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby><ruby>压<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yā</rt></ruby>；<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby><ruby>孽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niè</rt></ruby><ruby>加<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>身<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>怒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nù</rt></ruby><ruby>气<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby><ruby>逼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bī</rt></ruby><ruby>迫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pò</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>甚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shèn</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>疼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ténɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>痛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tònɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>惊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>惶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>临<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lín</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>身<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>恐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Kǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>惧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jù</rt></ruby><ruby>战<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhàn</rt></ruby><ruby>兢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>归<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuī</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>身<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby>；<ruby>惊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>恐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>漫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">màn</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>翅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chì</rt></ruby><ruby>膀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>鸽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡē</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>飞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēi</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>享<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby><ruby>息<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>远<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>游<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yóu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>宿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sù</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>旷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>野<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby>。<ruby>细<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xì</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby>

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>速<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sù</rt></ruby><ruby>速<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sù</rt></ruby><ruby>逃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">táo</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>避<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>脱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tuō</rt></ruby><ruby>离<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lí</rt></ruby><ruby>狂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>风<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>暴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bào</rt></ruby><ruby>雨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>吞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tūn</rt></ruby><ruby>灭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miè</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>变<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>乱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">luàn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>舌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shé</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tou</rt></ruby>！<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>城<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>强<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>暴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bào</rt></ruby><ruby>争<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>竞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>倚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>靠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kào</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>惧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jù</rt></ruby><ruby>怕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pà</rt></ruby>。<ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Rén</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>怎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zěn</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？

<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>怜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lián</rt></ruby><ruby>悯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǐn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>怜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lián</rt></ruby><ruby>悯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǐn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>！<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>投<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tóu</rt></ruby><ruby>靠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kào</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>。<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>投<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tóu</rt></ruby><ruby>靠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kào</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>翅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chì</rt></ruby><ruby>膀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>荫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby>，<ruby>等<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">děnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>灾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zāi</rt></ruby><ruby>害<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hài</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nà</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>吞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tūn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>辱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>骂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mà</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby>，<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>施<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shī</rt></ruby><ruby>恩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ēn</rt></ruby><ruby>救<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>慈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cí</rt></ruby><ruby>爱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ài</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>诚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>实<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>崇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>高<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>诸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhū</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby>！<ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>荣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>耀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>高<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>全<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby>！

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>脚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>设<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shè</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>网<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>罗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">luó</rt></ruby>，<ruby>压<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yā</rt></ruby><ruby>制<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>挖<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wā</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>坑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kēnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>反<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>掉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diào</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>其<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby>。<ruby>细<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xì</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby>

<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>坚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>定<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dìnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>坚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>定<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dìnɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>唱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>诗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shī</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>歌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡē</rt></ruby><ruby>颂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sònɡ</rt></ruby>！

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>灵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">línɡ</rt></ruby>（<ruby>原<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuán</rt></ruby><ruby>文<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wén</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby>“<ruby>荣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>耀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby>”）<ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>醒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby>！<ruby>琴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Qín</rt></ruby><ruby>瑟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>醒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby>！<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>极<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby><ruby>早<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>醒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby>！

<ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>万<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wàn</rt></ruby><ruby>民<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mín</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>称<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>谢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiè</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby><ruby>邦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>歌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡē</rt></ruby><ruby>颂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>！

<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>慈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cí</rt></ruby><ruby>爱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ài</rt></ruby><ruby>高<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>及<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby><ruby>诸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhū</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby>；<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>诚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>实<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>达<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dá</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>穹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>苍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cānɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>崇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>高<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>诸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhū</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby>！<ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>荣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>耀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>高<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>全<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby>！

<ruby>世<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>哪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>默<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mò</rt></ruby><ruby>然<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rán</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>语<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>真<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhēn</rt></ruby><ruby>合<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>公<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>吗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mɑ</rt></ruby>？<ruby>施<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shī</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>审<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shěn</rt></ruby><ruby>判<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>岂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>按<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby><ruby>正<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>直<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhí</rt></ruby><ruby>吗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mɑ</rt></ruby>？

<ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">È</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>母<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>胎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tāi</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>疏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shū</rt></ruby><ruby>远<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuǎn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>离<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lí</rt></ruby><ruby>母<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>腹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>便<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>走<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>错<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cuò</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>谎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>毒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dú</rt></ruby><ruby>气<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby><ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>蛇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shé</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>毒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dú</rt></ruby><ruby>气<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>塞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sāi</rt></ruby><ruby>耳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ěr</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>聋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>虺<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǐ</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>磨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mó</rt></ruby><ruby>舌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shé</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>刀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dāo</rt></ruby>，<ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>苦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>毒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dú</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>言<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yán</rt></ruby><ruby>语<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>准<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>箭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>暗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>射<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shè</rt></ruby><ruby>完<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wán</rt></ruby><ruby>全<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>忽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hū</rt></ruby><ruby>然<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rán</rt></ruby><ruby>射<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shè</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>惧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jù</rt></ruby><ruby>怕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pà</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>彼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>勉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>励<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>设<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shè</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby><ruby>计<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>商<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>量<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>暗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby><ruby>设<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shè</rt></ruby><ruby>网<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>罗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">luó</rt></ruby>，<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>谁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shuí</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby>？”

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>图<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>谋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">móu</rt></ruby><ruby>奸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby>，<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>极<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby><ruby>力<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>图<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>谋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">móu</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。”<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>意<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>念<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niàn</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>思<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">si</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>深<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dàn</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>射<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shè</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>忽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hū</rt></ruby><ruby>然<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rán</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>箭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>射<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shè</rt></ruby><ruby>伤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shānɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>然<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rán</rt></ruby><ruby>绊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bàn</rt></ruby><ruby>跌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diē</rt></ruby>，<ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>舌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shé</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tou</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>害<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hài</rt></ruby>；<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>摇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yáo</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tóu</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>害<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hài</rt></ruby><ruby>怕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pà</rt></ruby>，<ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>传<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuán</rt></ruby><ruby>扬<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yánɡ</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>工<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby>，<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>且<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiě</rt></ruby><ruby>明<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>白<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bɑi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>欢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huān</rt></ruby><ruby>喜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>投<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tóu</rt></ruby><ruby>靠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>；<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fán</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>正<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>直<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhí</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>夸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuā</rt></ruby><ruby>口<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒu</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<mark class="pn"><ruby>锡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xī</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>等<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">děnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>赞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zàn</rt></ruby><ruby>美<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">měi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>许<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>偿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>还<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huán</rt></ruby>。

verses.text: <ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>祷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>血<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xuè</rt></ruby><ruby>气<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zuì</rt></ruby><ruby>孽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niè</rt></ruby><ruby>胜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>至<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>犯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>赦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shè</rt></ruby><ruby>免<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miǎn</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>拣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>选<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xuǎn</rt></ruby>、<ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>亲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qīn</rt></ruby><ruby>近<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>、<ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>院<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>便<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>福<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby>！<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>居<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jū</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby>、<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>圣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>殿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diàn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>美<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">měi</rt></ruby><ruby>福<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>足<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zú</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>拯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhěnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>救<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>威<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wēi</rt></ruby><ruby>严<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yán</rt></ruby><ruby>秉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>公<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>应<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>允<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>；<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>本<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">běn</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>极<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>海<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>远<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>处<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chù</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>倚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>靠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kào</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>既<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>束<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shù</rt></ruby><ruby>腰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yāo</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>力<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>量<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby><ruby>定<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>诸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhū</rt></ruby><ruby>山<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shān</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>狂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>傲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ào</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>享<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>平<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>怀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huái</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>平<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pínɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>疼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ténɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>痛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tònɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>力<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>气<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qi</rt></ruby><ruby>却<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>壮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>实<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shi</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>别<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bié</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>苦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǔ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>别<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bié</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>遭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zāo</rt></ruby><ruby>灾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zāi</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>骄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiāo</rt></ruby><ruby>傲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ào</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>链<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liàn</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>戴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>项<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>强<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>暴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bào</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>衣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>裳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shɑnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>遮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhē</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>身<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>体<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tǐ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>眼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>睛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jinɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>体<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>胖<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>而<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>凸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tū</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>想<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>讥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jī</rt></ruby><ruby>笑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiào</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>凭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby><ruby>意<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>欺<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby><ruby>压<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yā</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>高<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>口<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>亵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiè</rt></ruby><ruby>渎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dú</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>舌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shé</rt></ruby><ruby>毁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>谤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>全<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>民<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mín</rt></ruby><ruby>归<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuī</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>喝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hē</rt></ruby><ruby>尽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>满<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>杯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bēi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>苦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǐ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>怎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zěn</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>晓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>？<ruby>至<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>高<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>者<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhě</rt></ruby><ruby>岂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>识<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shi</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？”

<ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>哪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>既<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>常<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>享<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby><ruby>逸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>财<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cái</rt></ruby><ruby>宝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>便<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>加<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>增<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zēnɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>实<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>然<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rán</rt></ruby><ruby>洁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby><ruby>净<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>然<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rán</rt></ruby><ruby>洗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>手<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>表<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>明<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wú</rt></ruby><ruby>辜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡū</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>终<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby><ruby>遭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zāo</rt></ruby><ruby>灾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zāi</rt></ruby><ruby>难<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nàn</rt></ruby>；<ruby>每<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">měi</rt></ruby><ruby>早<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>晨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chen</rt></ruby><ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>惩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>治<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>，“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>讲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎnɡ</rt></ruby>”，<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>奸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>诈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhà</rt></ruby><ruby>待<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>思<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby><ruby>索<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>怎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zěn</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>明<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>白<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bɑi</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>眼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>实<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>系<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xì</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>难<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nán</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>等<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Děnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>进<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>圣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>思<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby><ruby>想<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>结<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby><ruby>局<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jú</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>实<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>滑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>掉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diào</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>沉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chén</rt></ruby><ruby>沦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lún</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>转<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>眼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>间<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>成<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>何<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>等<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">děnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>荒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>凉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liánɡ</rt></ruby>！<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>惊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>恐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>灭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miè</rt></ruby><ruby>尽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。
