<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>伸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>诉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sù</rt></ruby>！<ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>记<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>念<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niàn</rt></ruby><ruby>愚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>顽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wán</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>怎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zěn</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>终<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby><ruby>辱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>骂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mà</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>忘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>记<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>敌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dí</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>声<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>音<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby>；<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>敌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dí</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>喧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xuān</rt></ruby><ruby>哗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>常<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>升<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>称<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>谢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiè</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>称<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>谢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiè</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>！<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>相<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>近<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>述<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shù</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>奇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>妙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miào</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby>。
verses.heading: 神是审判者

verses.text: <ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>定<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby><ruby>期<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby>，<ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>按<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby><ruby>正<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>直<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhí</rt></ruby><ruby>施<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shī</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>审<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shěn</rt></ruby><ruby>判<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pàn</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dì</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>其<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>居<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jū</rt></ruby><ruby>民<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mín</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>消<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiāo</rt></ruby><ruby>化<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>；<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>曾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>立<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>柱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>。<ruby>细<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xì</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby>

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>狂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>傲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ào</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>狂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>傲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ào</rt></ruby>！”<ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Duì</rt></ruby><ruby>凶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>举<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>角<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎo</rt></ruby>！

<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>角<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>高<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>举<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǔ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>挺<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>颈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>项<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>高<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>举<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>非<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēi</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>东<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>非<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēi</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>非<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēi</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>南<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nán</rt></ruby><ruby>而<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>惟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>断<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duàn</rt></ruby><ruby>定<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dìnɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>降<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>卑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bēi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>升<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>高<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>手<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>杯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bēi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>其<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>酒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>沫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mò</rt></ruby>，<ruby>杯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bēi</rt></ruby><ruby>内<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nèi</rt></ruby><ruby>满<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>搀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chān</rt></ruby><ruby>杂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zá</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>酒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǔ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>喝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hē</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>酒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>渣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhā</rt></ruby><ruby>滓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>而<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>且<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiě</rt></ruby><ruby>喝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hē</rt></ruby><ruby>尽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>宣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xuān</rt></ruby><ruby>扬<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yánɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>直<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhí</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>永<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>远<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuǎn</rt></ruby>！<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>歌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡē</rt></ruby><ruby>颂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sònɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby>！

<ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">È</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>角<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎo</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>砍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>断<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duàn</rt></ruby>；<ruby>惟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>角<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>高<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>举<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǔ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zài</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>犹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yóu</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby></mark>，　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>认<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rèn</rt></ruby><ruby>识<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shi</rt></ruby>；<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby>。
verses.heading: 神是胜利者

verses.text: <ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Sā</rt></ruby><ruby>冷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lěnɡ</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>帐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>幕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby>；<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>锡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xī</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>居<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jū</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>折<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhé</rt></ruby><ruby>断<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duàn</rt></ruby><ruby>弓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>火<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>箭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>盾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dùn</rt></ruby><ruby>牌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pái</rt></ruby>、<ruby>刀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dāo</rt></ruby><ruby>剑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>争<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>战<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhàn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>兵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>器<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby>。<ruby>细<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xì</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby>

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>野<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>食<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>山<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shān</rt></ruby><ruby>而<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>荣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>美<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">měi</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>勇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>敢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>抢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>夺<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duó</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>睡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuì</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>觉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby>，<ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>英<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>雄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>措<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cuò</rt></ruby><ruby>手<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>斥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chì</rt></ruby><ruby>责<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zé</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>坐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>车<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chē</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>、<ruby>骑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>马<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>沉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chén</rt></ruby><ruby>睡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuì</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>惟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>独<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>畏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>！<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>怒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nù</rt></ruby><ruby>气<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>谁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuí</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>站<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhàn</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>判<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pàn</rt></ruby><ruby>断<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duàn</rt></ruby>。<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>施<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shī</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>审<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shěn</rt></ruby><ruby>判<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>救<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby><ruby>谦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiān</rt></ruby><ruby>卑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bēi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>；<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>惧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jù</rt></ruby><ruby>怕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pà</rt></ruby><ruby>而<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>静<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>默<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mò</rt></ruby>。<ruby>细<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xì</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby>

<ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>忿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fèn</rt></ruby><ruby>怒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nù</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>成<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>全<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>荣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>美<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">měi</rt></ruby>；<ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>余<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>怒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>禁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>止<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>许<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>还<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huán</rt></ruby><ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby>；<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zài</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>四<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sì</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>拿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ná</rt></ruby><ruby>贡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>物<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby><ruby>献<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>畏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>挫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cuò</rt></ruby><ruby>折<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhé</rt></ruby><ruby>王<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>骄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiāo</rt></ruby><ruby>气<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>君<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jūn</rt></ruby><ruby>王<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>显<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>威<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wēi</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>畏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>声<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>呼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hū</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby>；<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>声<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>留<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liú</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>。
verses.heading: 遇难时得安慰

verses.text: <ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>患<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huàn</rt></ruby><ruby>难<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nàn</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby><ruby>寻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xún</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>夜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yè</rt></ruby><ruby>间<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>举<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>手<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>祷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby>；<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>肯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kěn</rt></ruby><ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby><ruby>慰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>想<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>念<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niàn</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>烦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby>燥<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby>；<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>沉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chén</rt></ruby><ruby>吟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yín</rt></ruby><ruby>悲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bēi</rt></ruby><ruby>伤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shānɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>便<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>昏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hūn</rt></ruby>。<ruby>细<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xì</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby>

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>闭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>眼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎn</rt></ruby>；<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>烦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>乱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">luàn</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby>，<ruby>甚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shèn</rt></ruby><ruby>至<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>追<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuī</rt></ruby><ruby>想<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>古<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>古<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>年<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nián</rt></ruby>。

verses.text: <ruby>唱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Chànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>诗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shī</rt></ruby><ruby>歌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡē</rt></ruby>，<ruby>打<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>手<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>鼓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǔ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>弹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tán</rt></ruby><ruby>美<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">měi</rt></ruby><ruby>琴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qín</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>瑟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>月<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuè</rt></ruby><ruby>朔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuò</rt></ruby><ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>月<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuè</rt></ruby><ruby>望<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wànɡ</rt></ruby>、<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>节<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby><ruby>期<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby><ruby>吹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuī</rt></ruby><ruby>角<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎo</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>定<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>律<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǜ</rt></ruby><ruby>例<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby></mark>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>典<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>章<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhānɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>攻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>击<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jī</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>埃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Āi</rt></ruby><ruby>及<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby>，<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>瑟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>间<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>立<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>证<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby>。<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>明<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>白<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bɑi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>言<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yán</rt></ruby><ruby>语<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby>：

<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>肩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>脱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tuō</rt></ruby><ruby>重<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>担<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>手<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>放<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>筐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>急<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby><ruby>难<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nàn</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>呼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hū</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>搭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dā</rt></ruby><ruby>救<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>雷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">léi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>隐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐn</rt></ruby><ruby>密<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mì</rt></ruby><ruby>处<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chù</rt></ruby><ruby>应<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>允<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>米<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>巴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bā</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>试<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>验<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yàn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>。<ruby>细<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xì</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby>

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>民<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mín</rt></ruby><ruby>哪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>劝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quàn</rt></ruby><ruby>戒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiè</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>；<mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>甚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shèn</rt></ruby><ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>肯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kěn</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zài</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>别<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bié</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby>；<ruby>外<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wài</rt></ruby><ruby>邦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>拜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bài</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>曾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>埃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">āi</rt></ruby><ruby>及<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>领<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>；<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>张<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>口<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>充<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>满<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎn</rt></ruby>。

“<ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wú</rt></ruby><ruby>奈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nài</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>民<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mín</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>声<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>音<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby>；<mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>全<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>理<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>便<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>任<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rèn</rt></ruby><ruby>凭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>刚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>硬<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yìnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>随<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suí</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>计<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>谋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">móu</rt></ruby><ruby>而<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>甚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shèn</rt></ruby><ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>民<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mín</rt></ruby><ruby>肯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kěn</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>，<mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>肯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kěn</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>便<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>速<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sù</rt></ruby><ruby>速<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sù</rt></ruby><ruby>治<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>服<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>仇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chóu</rt></ruby><ruby>敌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dí</rt></ruby>，<ruby>反<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>手<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>攻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>击<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jī</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>敌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dí</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>恨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Hèn</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>投<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tóu</rt></ruby><ruby>降<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiánɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>百<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>姓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>永<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>久<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>存<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cún</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>拿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ná</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>麦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mài</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby>，<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>拿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ná</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>磐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pán</rt></ruby><ruby>石<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>蜂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>蜜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mì</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>饱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>足<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zú</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>站<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhàn</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>权<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby><ruby>力<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>者<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhě</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>会<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>诸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhū</rt></ruby><ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>审<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shěn</rt></ruby><ruby>判<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pàn</rt></ruby>，
verses.heading: 神是最高的主宰

verses.text: <ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>审<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shěn</rt></ruby><ruby>判<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pàn</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>秉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>公<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>徇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xùn</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>情<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>几<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？<ruby>细<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xì</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby>

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>贫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pín</rt></ruby><ruby>寒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hán</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>孤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡū</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>伸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>冤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuān</rt></ruby>；<ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>困<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kùn</rt></ruby><ruby>苦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>穷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>乏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fá</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>施<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shī</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>公<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>保<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>护<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hù</rt></ruby><ruby>贫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pín</rt></ruby><ruby>寒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hán</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>穷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>乏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fá</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>救<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>脱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tuō</rt></ruby><ruby>离<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lí</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>手<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>仍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>明<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>白<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bɑi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>黑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hēi</rt></ruby><ruby>暗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>走<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>走<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>；<ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>根<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡēn</rt></ruby><ruby>基<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jī</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>摇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yáo</rt></ruby><ruby>动<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>曾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>至<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>高<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>者<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhě</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>然<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rán</rt></ruby><ruby>而<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>世<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>仆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pū</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby>，<ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>王<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>位<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>审<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shěn</rt></ruby><ruby>判<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pàn</rt></ruby><ruby>世<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>界<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiè</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>万<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wàn</rt></ruby><ruby>邦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>业<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yè</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>静<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>默<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mò</rt></ruby>！<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>闭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>口<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>声<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby>！

verses.text: <ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>仇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chóu</rt></ruby><ruby>敌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dí</rt></ruby><ruby>喧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xuān</rt></ruby><ruby>嚷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rǎnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>恨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hèn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>抬<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tái</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tóu</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>谋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">móu</rt></ruby><ruby>奸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>诈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhà</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>害<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hài</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>百<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>姓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>彼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>商<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>议<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>害<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hài</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>隐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐn</rt></ruby><ruby>藏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Lái</rt></ruby><ruby>吧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>剪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>灭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miè</rt></ruby>，<ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>再<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>成<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>国<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuó</rt></ruby>！<ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>再<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>记<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>念<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niàn</rt></ruby>！”

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>商<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>议<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>彼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>结<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby><ruby>盟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ménɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>抵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>挡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>帐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>棚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>东<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōnɡ</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>实<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>玛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<mark class="pn"><ruby>摩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mó</rt></ruby><ruby>押<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yā</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>夏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xià</rt></ruby><ruby>甲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎ</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，

<mark class="pn"><ruby>迦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>巴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bā</rt></ruby><ruby>勒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lè</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>扪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>玛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>力<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>非<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fēi</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>士<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>推<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tuī</rt></ruby><ruby>罗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">luó</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>居<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jū</rt></ruby><ruby>民<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mín</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>述<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shù</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>连<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lián</rt></ruby><ruby>合<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>罗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Luó</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>孙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sūn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>帮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>手<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby>。<ruby>细<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xì</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby>

<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>待<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>待<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>米<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>甸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diàn</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>基<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jī</rt></ruby><ruby>顺<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shùn</rt></ruby><ruby>河<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>待<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xī</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>宾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bīn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>隐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐn</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby><ruby>珥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ěr</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>灭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miè</rt></ruby><ruby>亡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wánɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>成<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>粪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fèn</rt></ruby><ruby>土<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tǔ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>首<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>领<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>俄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">É</rt></ruby><ruby>立<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xī</rt></ruby><ruby>伊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>伯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bó</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>王<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xī</rt></ruby><ruby>巴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bā</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Sā</rt></ruby><ruby>慕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>拿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ná</rt></ruby></mark>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>处<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>产<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>业<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yè</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>旋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>风<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>尘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chén</rt></ruby><ruby>土<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tǔ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>风<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>碎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suì</rt></ruby><ruby>秸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiē</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>火<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Huǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>怎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zěn</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>焚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fén</rt></ruby><ruby>烧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shāo</rt></ruby><ruby>树<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shù</rt></ruby><ruby>林<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lín</rt></ruby>，<ruby>火<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>焰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yàn</rt></ruby><ruby>怎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zěn</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>烧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shāo</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zháo</rt></ruby><ruby>山<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shān</rt></ruby><ruby>岭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐnɡ</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>照<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhào</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>狂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>风<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>追<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuī</rt></ruby><ruby>赶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>暴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bào</rt></ruby><ruby>雨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>恐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>吓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hè</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>满<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>羞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiū</rt></ruby><ruby>耻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>寻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xún</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby>！

<ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>永<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>远<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>羞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiū</rt></ruby><ruby>愧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuì</rt></ruby><ruby>惊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>惶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huánɡ</rt></ruby>！<ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>惭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cán</rt></ruby><ruby>愧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuì</rt></ruby><ruby>灭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miè</rt></ruby><ruby>亡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wánɡ</rt></ruby>！

<ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby>：<ruby>惟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>独<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>全<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>至<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>高<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>者<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhě</rt></ruby>！

<ruby>万<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wàn</rt></ruby><ruby>军<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jūn</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>居<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jū</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>何<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>等<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">děnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>爱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ài</rt></ruby>！
verses.heading: 渴慕耶和华的殿宇

verses.text: <ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>羡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>慕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>渴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>想<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>院<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>宇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>肠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chánɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>肉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ròu</rt></ruby><ruby>体<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>永<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>呼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hū</rt></ruby><ruby>吁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby>（<ruby>或<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huò</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby>“<ruby>欢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huān</rt></ruby><ruby>呼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hū</rt></ruby>”）。

<ruby>万<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wàn</rt></ruby><ruby>军<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jūn</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>王<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wánɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>坛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tán</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>麻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">má</rt></ruby><ruby>雀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>找<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zháo</rt></ruby><ruby>房<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>屋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wū</rt></ruby>，<ruby>燕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yàn</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>找<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zháo</rt></ruby><ruby>抱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bào</rt></ruby><ruby>雏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chú</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>窝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wō</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Rú</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>殿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diàn</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>便<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>福<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby>！<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>仍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>赞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zàn</rt></ruby><ruby>美<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">měi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>。<ruby>细<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xì</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby>

<ruby>靠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Kào</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>力<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>量<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liànɡ</rt></ruby>、<ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>想<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>往<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǎnɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>锡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xī</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>便<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>福<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby>！

verses.text: <ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>曾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>慈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cí</rt></ruby><ruby>悲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bēi</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>建<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>立<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>永<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>远<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuǎn</rt></ruby>；<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby><ruby>实<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>坚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>立<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>。
