verses.text: <ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>智<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>慧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>完<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wán</rt></ruby><ruby>全<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby>。<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>几<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>存<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cún</rt></ruby><ruby>完<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wán</rt></ruby><ruby>全<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>邪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xié</rt></ruby><ruby>僻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pì</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>摆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>眼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby>；<ruby>悖<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>逆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby>做<ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>甚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shèn</rt></ruby><ruby>恨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hèn</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>容<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>沾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhān</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>身<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>弯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wān</rt></ruby><ruby>曲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qū</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>思<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">si</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>远<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>离<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lí</rt></ruby>；<ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>（<ruby>或<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huò</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby>“<ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>”），<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>认<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rèn</rt></ruby><ruby>识<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shi</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zài</rt></ruby><ruby>暗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>谗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chán</rt></ruby><ruby>谤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>邻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lín</rt></ruby><ruby>居<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jū</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>灭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miè</rt></ruby><ruby>绝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jué</rt></ruby>；<ruby>眼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>目<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>高<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>傲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ào</rt></ruby>、<ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>骄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiāo</rt></ruby><ruby>纵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>容<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>眼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>国<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuó</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>诚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>实<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby>；<ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>完<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wán</rt></ruby><ruby>全<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>伺<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cì</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>诡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>诈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhà</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>谎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>立<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>眼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>每<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">měi</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby><ruby>早<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>晨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chen</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>灭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miè</rt></ruby><ruby>绝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jué</rt></ruby><ruby>国<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuó</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>孽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niè</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>城<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>剪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>除<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chú</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>祷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby>，<ruby>容<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>呼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hū</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>达<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dá</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby>！
verses.heading: 遭难中的祈祷

verses.text: <ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>急<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby><ruby>难<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nàn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>侧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cè</rt></ruby><ruby>耳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ěr</rt></ruby>；<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>掩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby>！<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>呼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hū</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>快<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuài</rt></ruby><ruby>快<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuài</rt></ruby><ruby>应<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>允<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>！

<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>年<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nián</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>烟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yān</rt></ruby><ruby>云<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yún</rt></ruby><ruby>消<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiāo</rt></ruby><ruby>灭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miè</rt></ruby>；<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>骨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tou</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>火<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>烧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shāo</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zháo</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>伤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shānɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>草<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>枯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kū</rt></ruby><ruby>干<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡān</rt></ruby>，<ruby>甚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shèn</rt></ruby><ruby>至<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>忘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>记<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>饭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fàn</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>唉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">āi</rt></ruby><ruby>哼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>声<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>音<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>肉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ròu</rt></ruby><ruby>紧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐn</rt></ruby><ruby>贴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiē</rt></ruby><ruby>骨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tou</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>旷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>野<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>鹈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tí</rt></ruby><ruby>鹕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hú</rt></ruby>；<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>荒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>场<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>鸮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiāo</rt></ruby><ruby>鸟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niǎo</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>警<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>醒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>睡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuì</rt></ruby>；<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>房<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>顶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>孤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡū</rt></ruby><ruby>单<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dān</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>麻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">má</rt></ruby><ruby>雀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby><ruby>国<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuó</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>赐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cì</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>便<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>承<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>民<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mín</rt></ruby><ruby>劳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">láo</rt></ruby><ruby>碌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>赞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zàn</rt></ruby><ruby>美<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">měi</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby>！<ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yào</rt></ruby><ruby>称<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>谢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiè</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>本<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">běn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>善<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shàn</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>慈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cí</rt></ruby><ruby>爱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ài</rt></ruby><ruby>永<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>远<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>存<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cún</rt></ruby>！

<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fán</rt></ruby><ruby>遵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zūn</rt></ruby><ruby>守<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>公<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>平<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pínɡ</rt></ruby>、<ruby>常<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>公<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>便<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>福<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby>！

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>恩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ēn</rt></ruby><ruby>惠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby><ruby>待<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>百<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>姓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìnɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>恩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ēn</rt></ruby><ruby>惠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby><ruby>记<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>念<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niàn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>开<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kāi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>救<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>恩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ēn</rt></ruby><ruby>眷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">juàn</rt></ruby><ruby>顾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡù</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>选<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>民<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mín</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>福<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby>，<ruby>乐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lè</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>国<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuó</rt></ruby><ruby>民<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mín</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>乐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lè</rt></ruby>，<ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>产<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>业<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yè</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>夸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuā</rt></ruby><ruby>耀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>祖<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>宗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zonɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>犯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fàn</rt></ruby><ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby>；<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>孽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niè</rt></ruby>，<ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>祖<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>宗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zonɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>埃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Āi</rt></ruby><ruby>及<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>明<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>白<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bɑi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>奇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>记<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>念<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niàn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>丰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>盛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>慈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cí</rt></ruby><ruby>爱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ài</rt></ruby>，<ruby>反<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>红<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Hónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>海<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎi</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>悖<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>逆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nì</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>然<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Rán</rt></ruby><ruby>而<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>拯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhěnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>救<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>彰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>显<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>且<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiě</rt></ruby><ruby>斥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chì</rt></ruby><ruby>责<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zé</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>红<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Hónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>海<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎi</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>海<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>便<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>干<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡān</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>带<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>领<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>经<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>深<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>处<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>经<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>旷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>野<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>拯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhěnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>救<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>脱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tuō</rt></ruby><ruby>离<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lí</rt></ruby><ruby>恨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hèn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>手<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>仇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chóu</rt></ruby><ruby>敌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dí</rt></ruby><ruby>手<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>救<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>赎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shú</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>拯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhěnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>救<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>外<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wài</rt></ruby><ruby>邦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>招<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhāo</rt></ruby><ruby>聚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jù</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>称<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>赞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zàn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>圣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>赞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zàn</rt></ruby><ruby>美<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">měi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>夸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuā</rt></ruby><ruby>胜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>应<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>称<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>颂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>亘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡèn</rt></ruby><ruby>古<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>直<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhí</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>永<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>远<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuǎn</rt></ruby>。<ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>民<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mín</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>阿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Ā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>！”<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>赞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zàn</rt></ruby><ruby>美<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">měi</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby>！

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>称<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>谢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiè</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>本<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">běn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>善<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shàn</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>慈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cí</rt></ruby><ruby>爱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ài</rt></ruby><ruby>永<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>远<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>存<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cún</rt></ruby>！

verses.text: <ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>赎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shú</rt></ruby><ruby>民<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mín</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>敌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dí</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>手<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>救<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>赎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shú</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>饥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jī</rt></ruby><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>渴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby>，<ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>昏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hūn</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>苦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>难<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nàn</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>哀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">āi</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>祸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huò</rt></ruby><ruby>患<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huàn</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>搭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dā</rt></ruby><ruby>救<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>慈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cí</rt></ruby><ruby>爱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ài</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>奇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>称<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>赞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zàn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>渴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>慕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>足<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zú</rt></ruby>，<ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>饥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jī</rt></ruby><ruby>饿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>饱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>美<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">měi</rt></ruby><ruby>物<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>违<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>背<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby><ruby>语<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>藐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>视<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>至<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>高<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>者<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhě</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>旨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>意<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>沧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Cānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>海<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>奔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bēn</rt></ruby><ruby>逃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">táo</rt></ruby>；<mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>旦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>河<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>流<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liú</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dà</rt></ruby><ruby>山<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shān</rt></ruby><ruby>踊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>跃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuè</rt></ruby>，<ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>公<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>羊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yánɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>小<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>山<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shān</rt></ruby><ruby>跳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiào</rt></ruby><ruby>舞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǔ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>羊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>羔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>沧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Cānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>海<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>何<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>奔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bēn</rt></ruby><ruby>逃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">táo</rt></ruby>？<mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>旦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dàn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>哪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>何<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>流<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liú</rt></ruby>？

<ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dà</rt></ruby><ruby>山<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shān</rt></ruby><ruby>哪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>何<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>踊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>跃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuè</rt></ruby>，<ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>公<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>羊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yánɡ</rt></ruby>？<ruby>小<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>山<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shān</rt></ruby><ruby>哪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>何<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>跳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiào</rt></ruby><ruby>舞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǔ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>羊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>羔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby>？

<ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dà</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby></mark>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>便<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>震<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhèn</rt></ruby><ruby>动<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dònɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>磐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pán</rt></ruby><ruby>石<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>变<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>池<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chí</rt></ruby>，<ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>坚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>石<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>变<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>泉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby><ruby>源<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuán</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>荣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>耀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>归<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuī</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>归<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuī</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>；<ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>慈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cí</rt></ruby><ruby>爱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ài</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>诚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>实<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>归<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuī</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby>！

verses.text: <ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>何<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>容<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>外<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wài</rt></ruby><ruby>邦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>哪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？”

<ruby>然<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Rán</rt></ruby><ruby>而<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>随<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suí</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>意<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>旨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>偶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>金<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>银<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yín</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>手<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>造<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zào</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>口<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>却<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>言<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yán</rt></ruby>，<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>眼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>却<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>耳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ěr</rt></ruby><ruby>却<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>鼻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bí</rt></ruby><ruby>却<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>闻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wén</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>手<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>却<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>摸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mō</rt></ruby>，<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>脚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>却<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>走<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǒu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>喉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hóu</rt></ruby><ruby>咙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>声<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>造<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>靠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>倚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>靠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kào</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby>！<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>帮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>助<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>盾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dùn</rt></ruby><ruby>牌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pái</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>伦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lún</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>倚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>靠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kào</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby>！<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>帮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>助<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>盾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dùn</rt></ruby><ruby>牌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pái</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>敬<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>畏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>倚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>靠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kào</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby>！<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>帮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>助<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>盾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dùn</rt></ruby><ruby>牌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pái</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>眷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">juàn</rt></ruby><ruby>念<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niàn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>还<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>赐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cì</rt></ruby><ruby>福<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>：<ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>赐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cì</rt></ruby><ruby>福<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>赐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cì</rt></ruby><ruby>福<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>伦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lún</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fán</rt></ruby><ruby>敬<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>畏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wú</rt></ruby><ruby>论<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lùn</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>小<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎo</rt></ruby>，<ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>赐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cì</rt></ruby><ruby>福<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>蒙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ménɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>造<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zào</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>福<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby>！

<ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tiān</rt></ruby>，<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby>；<ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>却<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>世<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>赞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zàn</rt></ruby><ruby>美<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">měi</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby>；<ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>寂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>静<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>称<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>颂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby>，<ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>今<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīn</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>直<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhí</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>永<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>远<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuǎn</rt></ruby>。<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>赞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zàn</rt></ruby><ruby>美<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">měi</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby>！

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>爱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ài</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>声<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>音<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>恳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kěn</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby>。

verses.text: <ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>既<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>侧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cè</rt></ruby><ruby>耳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ěr</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yāo</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>亡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>绳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>索<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>缠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chán</rt></ruby><ruby>绕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rào</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>阴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>间<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>痛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>苦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>抓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuā</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>遭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zāo</rt></ruby><ruby>遇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><ruby>患<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huàn</rt></ruby><ruby>难<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nàn</rt></ruby><ruby>愁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chóu</rt></ruby><ruby>苦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǔ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nà</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>便<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>救<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>灵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">línɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>魂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hún</rt></ruby>！”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>恩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ēn</rt></ruby><ruby>惠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>公<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby>；<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>怜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lián</rt></ruby><ruby>悯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǐn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>怀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huái</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>保<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>护<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hù</rt></ruby><ruby>愚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>；<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>落<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">luò</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>卑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bēi</rt></ruby><ruby>微<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wēi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>步<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>救<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>哪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nɑ</rt></ruby>！<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>仍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>归<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuī</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby><ruby>乐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lè</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>厚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>恩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ēn</rt></ruby><ruby>待<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>救<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>命<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>免<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>亡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wánɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>救<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>眼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>免<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>流<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liú</rt></ruby><ruby>泪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lèi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>救<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>脚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>免<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>跌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diē</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>活<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huó</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>未<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>苦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>先<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiān</rt></ruby><ruby>走<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>迷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mí</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>现<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>却<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>遵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zūn</rt></ruby><ruby>守<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>本<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">běn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>善<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>善<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shàn</rt></ruby>；<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>律<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǜ</rt></ruby><ruby>例<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>教<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>训<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xùn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>！

<ruby>骄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiāo</rt></ruby><ruby>傲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ào</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>编<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biān</rt></ruby><ruby>造<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zào</rt></ruby><ruby>谎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>言<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yán</rt></ruby><ruby>攻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>击<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jī</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>却<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>守<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>训<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xùn</rt></ruby><ruby>词<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cí</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>蒙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ménɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>脂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>油<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yóu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>却<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>喜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>爱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ài</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>律<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǜ</rt></ruby><ruby>法<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>苦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>益<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>学<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xué</rt></ruby><ruby>习<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xí</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>律<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǜ</rt></ruby><ruby>例<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>口<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>训<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xùn</rt></ruby><ruby>言<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yán</rt></ruby>（<ruby>或<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huò</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby>“<ruby>律<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǜ</rt></ruby><ruby>法<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎ</rt></ruby>”）<ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>益<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>胜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>千<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiān</rt></ruby><ruby>万<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wàn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>金<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīn</rt></ruby><ruby>银<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yín</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>手<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>制<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>造<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zào</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>建<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>立<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>赐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>悟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby><ruby>性<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>学<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xué</rt></ruby><ruby>习<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xí</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>命<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>令<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lìnɡ</rt></ruby>！
