verses.text: <ruby>敬<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>畏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>欢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huān</rt></ruby><ruby>喜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>仰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>望<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>判<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pàn</rt></ruby><ruby>语<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>公<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>；<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>苦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>诚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>实<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>待<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>照<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhào</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>应<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>许<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>仆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pú</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby>，<ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>慈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cí</rt></ruby><ruby>爱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ài</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby><ruby>慰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>慈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cí</rt></ruby><ruby>悲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bēi</rt></ruby><ruby>临<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lín</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>存<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cún</rt></ruby><ruby>活<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huó</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>律<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǜ</rt></ruby><ruby>法<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>喜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>爱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ài</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>骄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiāo</rt></ruby><ruby>傲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ào</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>蒙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ménɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>羞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiū</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wú</rt></ruby><ruby>理<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>倾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>覆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>思<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby><ruby>想<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>训<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xùn</rt></ruby><ruby>词<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cí</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>敬<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>畏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>归<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuī</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>法<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>度<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dù</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>律<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǜ</rt></ruby><ruby>例<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>完<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wán</rt></ruby><ruby>全<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby>，<ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby>致<ruby>蒙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ménɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>羞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiū</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>渴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>想<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>救<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>恩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ēn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>仰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>望<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>应<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>许<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǔ</rt></ruby>。
verses.heading: 求主解救

verses.text: <ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>盼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pàn</rt></ruby><ruby>望<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>应<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>许<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>眼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>睛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jinɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>失<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shī</rt></ruby><ruby>明<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>何<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby><ruby>慰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>？”

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>性<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>命<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>常<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>危<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wēi</rt></ruby><ruby>险<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>却<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>忘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>记<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>律<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǜ</rt></ruby><ruby>法<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">È</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>设<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shè</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>网<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>罗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">luó</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>却<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>偏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">piān</rt></ruby><ruby>离<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lí</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>训<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xùn</rt></ruby><ruby>词<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cí</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>法<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>度<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dù</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>永<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>远<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>产<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>业<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yè</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>喜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>爱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ài</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>专<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuān</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>律<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǜ</rt></ruby><ruby>例<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>永<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>远<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>遵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zūn</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>直<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhí</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>底<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǐ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>怀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huái</rt></ruby><ruby>二<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">èr</rt></ruby><ruby>意<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>恨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hèn</rt></ruby>；<ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>律<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǜ</rt></ruby><ruby>法<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>爱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ài</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>哪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>离<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lí</rt></ruby><ruby>开<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kāi</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>吧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bɑ</rt></ruby>！<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>遵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zūn</rt></ruby><ruby>守<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>命<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>令<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lìnɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>照<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhào</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby><ruby>扶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby><ruby>持<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chí</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>存<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cún</rt></ruby><ruby>活<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huó</rt></ruby>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>失<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shī</rt></ruby><ruby>望<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>而<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>害<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hài</rt></ruby><ruby>羞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiū</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>扶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby><ruby>持<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chí</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>便<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>救<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>常<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>重<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>律<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǜ</rt></ruby><ruby>例<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby>。

verses.heading: 耶和华子民的安全

verses.text: <ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>山<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shān</rt></ruby><ruby>怎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zěn</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>围<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>绕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rào</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sā</rt></ruby><ruby>冷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lěnɡ</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>照<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhào</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>围<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>绕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>百<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>姓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>今<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīn</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>直<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhí</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>永<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>远<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuǎn</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">È</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>杖<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>常<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>落<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">luò</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>份<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fèn</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>免<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>伸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>手<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>善<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shàn</rt></ruby><ruby>待<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>些<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiē</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>善<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shàn</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>正<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>直<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhí</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>至<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>偏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">piān</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>弯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wān</rt></ruby><ruby>曲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qū</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>刑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby>。<ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>平<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby><ruby>归<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuī</rt></ruby><ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark>！

<ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>些<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiē</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>掳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>带<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>锡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby>做<ruby>梦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>。
verses.heading: 被掳归回者的欢乐

verses.text: <ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>满<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>口<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>喜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>笑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiào</rt></ruby>、<ruby>满<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>舌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shé</rt></ruby><ruby>欢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huān</rt></ruby><ruby>呼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hū</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby>，<ruby>外<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wài</rt></ruby><ruby>邦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>！”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>果<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>然<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rán</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>欢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huān</rt></ruby><ruby>喜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>掳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>归<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuī</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby>，<ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>南<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nán</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>河<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>复<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>流<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liú</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>进<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>帐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>幕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>床<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>榻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tà</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>容<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>眼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>睛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jinɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>睡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuì</rt></ruby><ruby>觉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>容<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>眼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>目<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>打<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>盹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǔn</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>直<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhí</rt></ruby><ruby>等<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">děnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>寻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xún</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby>，<ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>者<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhě</rt></ruby><ruby>寻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xún</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>居<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jū</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>柜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuì</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>法<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>基<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jī</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yē</rt></ruby><ruby>琳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lín</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>寻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xún</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>进<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>居<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jū</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>脚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>凳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>拜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bài</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>兴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>力<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>柜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuì</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>入<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rù</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby><ruby>息<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby>！

<ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>司<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby><ruby>披<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pī</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>公<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby>！<ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>圣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>民<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mín</rt></ruby><ruby>欢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huān</rt></ruby><ruby>呼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hū</rt></ruby>！

<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>仆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pú</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dà</rt></ruby><ruby>卫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>缘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuán</rt></ruby><ruby>故<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>厌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yàn</rt></ruby><ruby>弃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>膏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>者<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhě</rt></ruby>！

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>卫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby></mark>、<ruby>凭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>诚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>实<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>誓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>反<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>复<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>坐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>宝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>座<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>守<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>教<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>训<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xùn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>法<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>度<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>孙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sūn</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>永<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>远<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>坐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>宝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>座<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>拣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>选<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>锡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>意<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>居<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jū</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>永<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>远<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby><ruby>息<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>意<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>其<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>粮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>食<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shi</rt></ruby><ruby>丰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>满<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>其<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>穷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>饱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>足<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zú</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>司<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby><ruby>披<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pī</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>救<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>恩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ēn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>圣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>民<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mín</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>声<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>欢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huān</rt></ruby><ruby>呼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hū</rt></ruby>！

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dà</rt></ruby><ruby>卫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>角<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>膏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>者<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhě</rt></ruby><ruby>预<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><ruby>备<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>明<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>灯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dēnɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>仇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chóu</rt></ruby><ruby>敌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dí</rt></ruby><ruby>披<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pī</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>羞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiū</rt></ruby><ruby>耻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chǐ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>冠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuān</rt></ruby><ruby>冕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tóu</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuānɡ</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>骄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiāo</rt></ruby><ruby>傲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ào</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>暗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby><ruby>设<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shè</rt></ruby><ruby>网<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>罗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">luó</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>绳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>索<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby><ruby>旁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>铺<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pū</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>网<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǎnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>设<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shè</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>圈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quān</rt></ruby><ruby>套<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tào</rt></ruby>。<ruby>细<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xì</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby>

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>曾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby>。<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>留<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liú</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>恳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kěn</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>声<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>音<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby>！

<ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby>、<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>救<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>恩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ēn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>力<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>量<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>争<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>战<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhàn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>遮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhē</rt></ruby><ruby>蔽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tóu</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>遂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suì</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby>；<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>成<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>计<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>谋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">móu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>恐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>怕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pà</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>高<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby>。<ruby>细<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xì</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby>

<ruby>至<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>些<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiē</rt></ruby><ruby>昂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>首<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>围<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>困<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kùn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>嘴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>唇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chún</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>奸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby><ruby>陷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>害<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hài</rt></ruby>（<ruby>原<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuán</rt></ruby><ruby>文<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wén</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby>“<ruby>遮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhē</rt></ruby><ruby>蔽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby>”）<ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby>！

<ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>火<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>炭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tàn</rt></ruby><ruby>落<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">luò</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>身<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>！<ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>丢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diū</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>火<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>抛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pāo</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>深<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>坑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>再<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby><ruby>言<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yán</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>坚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>立<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby>；<ruby>祸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Huò</rt></ruby><ruby>患<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huàn</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>猎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby><ruby>取<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>强<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>暴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bào</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>打<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>曾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>哀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">āi</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby>。<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>避<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>难<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nàn</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>活<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huó</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>福<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby><ruby>分<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fèn</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>侧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cè</rt></ruby><ruby>耳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ěr</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>呼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hū</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>落<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">luò</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>极<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby><ruby>卑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bēi</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby>；<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>救<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>脱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tuō</rt></ruby><ruby>离<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lí</rt></ruby><ruby>逼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bī</rt></ruby><ruby>迫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pò</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>强<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>盛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>领<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>离<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lí</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>囚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>称<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>赞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zàn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby>。<ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>环<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huán</rt></ruby><ruby>绕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rào</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>厚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>恩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ēn</rt></ruby><ruby>待<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>祷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby>，<ruby>留<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liú</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>恳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kěn</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby>，<ruby>凭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby><ruby>实<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>公<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>应<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>允<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>原<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuán</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>仇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chóu</rt></ruby><ruby>敌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dí</rt></ruby><ruby>逼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bī</rt></ruby><ruby>迫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pò</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>打<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>幽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yōu</rt></ruby><ruby>暗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>处<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>许<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>久<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>灵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">línɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>昏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hūn</rt></ruby>；<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>凄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby><ruby>惨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǎn</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>追<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuī</rt></ruby><ruby>想<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>古<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>思<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby><ruby>想<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>默<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mò</rt></ruby><ruby>念<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niàn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>手<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>工<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>倚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>靠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kào</rt></ruby><ruby>君<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jūn</rt></ruby><ruby>王<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wánɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>倚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>靠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kào</rt></ruby><ruby>世<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>点<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>帮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>助<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>气<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>断<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>归<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuī</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>尘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chén</rt></ruby><ruby>土<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tǔ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>打<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>算<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suàn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>消<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiāo</rt></ruby><ruby>灭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miè</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>帮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>助<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby>、<ruby>仰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>望<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>便<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>福<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby>！

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>造<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zào</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby>、<ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby>、<ruby>海<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>其<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>万<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wàn</rt></ruby><ruby>物<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>守<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>诚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>实<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby>，<ruby>直<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhí</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>永<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>远<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuǎn</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>屈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qū</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>伸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>冤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuān</rt></ruby>，<ruby>赐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cì</rt></ruby><ruby>食<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>物<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>饥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jī</rt></ruby><ruby>饿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>释<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>放<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>囚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>开<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kāi</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>瞎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiā</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>眼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>睛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jinɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>扶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>压<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yā</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>。<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>喜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>爱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ài</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>保<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>护<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hù</rt></ruby><ruby>寄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>居<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jū</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>扶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby><ruby>持<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chí</rt></ruby><ruby>孤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡū</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>寡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>妇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>却<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby><ruby>弯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wān</rt></ruby><ruby>曲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qū</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>王<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wánɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>直<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhí</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>永<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>远<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuǎn</rt></ruby>！<mark class="pn"><ruby>锡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xī</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>哪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>王<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wánɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>直<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhí</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>万<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wàn</rt></ruby><ruby>代<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby>！<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>赞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zàn</rt></ruby><ruby>美<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">měi</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby>！

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>赞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zàn</rt></ruby><ruby>美<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">měi</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby>！<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>歌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡē</rt></ruby><ruby>颂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>善<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shàn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>美<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">měi</rt></ruby>；<ruby>赞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zàn</rt></ruby><ruby>美<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">měi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>合<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>宜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。
verses.heading: 赞美　神的全能

verses.text: <ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>建<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>造<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zào</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sā</rt></ruby><ruby>冷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lěnɡ</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>聚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jù</rt></ruby><ruby>集<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>赶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>散<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sàn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>医<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>伤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>裹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>伤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>处<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chù</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>数<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>点<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>星<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>宿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiù</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>数<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shù</rt></ruby><ruby>目<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>称<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>它<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby>，<ruby>最<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>力<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>智<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>慧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby><ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wú</rt></ruby><ruby>法<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>测<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cè</rt></ruby><ruby>度<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duó</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>扶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby><ruby>持<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chí</rt></ruby><ruby>谦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiān</rt></ruby><ruby>卑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bēi</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>倾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>覆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby>。
